# Hosts operated by this project or by people working with it — THE LIVE LIST. Committed on purpose.
#
# interop.py counts a peer, a witness or an implementation as "outside" only when its host is
# NOT covered by a line here. A host matches a line when it equals it or ends with "." + it.
# Adding a host here can only LOWER the outside counts; that is the safe direction, and a change
# to this file shows up in a diff.
#
# Rationale per line:
modelmarket.dev          # the reference hub, its satellites, oracles, HISTOR, THEMIS, SKOPOS, …
magic-ai-factory.com     # the factory's own market
attestedmemory.net       # Attested — a sibling ecosystem, deployed and operated by us
independentai.network    # Independent — a standard hub on a separate server, deployed by us
# Witnesses we run ourselves (HISTOR's own witness key) are matched by name, not host:
histor.modelmarket.dev/witness
